checks.expect: Accepted scans appear in the lab worklist within two seconds on the LAN.
Each scan has a stable client UUID used as idempotency key; retries cannot create duplicate samples.
Station posts batches to HTTPS API and receives accepted IDs synchronously after persistence.
Each lab region uses managed Postgres with encrypted backups and records stay in assigned region.
Seven-year audit retention applies; normalized records are queryable. The 90-day raw payload archive tier was not decided.
Whether raw payloads move to object storage after 90 days is open; Jun owns compliance retrieval/retention follow-up due next Thursday.
Kafka was tentative only if load test passes, then explicitly objected to because lab platform cannot support it. Final state leaves event transport open, not accepted.
Jun checks supported lab event transport by Friday.
Accepted v1 behavior is manual refresh plus 15-second polling; no live event stream.
Global edge ingest and data lake were analogy only, not adopted or tentative.
Graph database was explicitly illustrative, not a proposal or decision.
Sarcastic Rust rewrite is not captured as an accepted decision.
Synchronous endpoint question was answered immediately and is not left open.
Printer jam is not a design item.
Kubernetes is existing platform context, not a new platform component decision.
